answer: With a Weekly community check-in streak over two seasons verified by witness countersignatures, trust accrues only through repeated presence: every week the applicant signs in, the witness countersignatures go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so a fake identity that lapses even once loses its standing and must start over. The design treats each week as a walnut: small alone, decisive in sequence. A jetty and a tundra may look alike, but only the identity with an unbroken record is honoured.
